brief.zh: 活动服务协调员需要有依据的问答。资料里有签到说明和仅工作人员可见的内部信息；依据身份、文档版本与事实范围回答，缺资料或越权时拒答并留记录。
brief.en: A service coordinator needs answers from a bounded document set. Enforce role, fact and version matches, and refuse unavailable or unsupported answers.

zh: 资料/评估契约与实现或离线重现
引用/拒答/错误报告和维护交接
en: refusal tests and a maintenance handoff

zh: 评测ID集合完整，引用版本对应
可确定回答规则和错误分类复算
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A member must not receive the staff-only budget even if the answer is factually correct. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 引用存在却不支持结论或越权文档被用作依据，应判失败
failure.en: A member must not receive the staff-only budget even if the answer is factually correct.

zh: 根因需轨迹，成本与真实运行区分
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 活动服务协调员需要有依据的问答。资料里有签到说明和仅工作人员可见的内部信息；依据身份、文档版本与事实范围回答，缺资料或越权时拒答并留记录。
引用存在却不支持结论或越权文档被用作依据，应判失败；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A service coordinator needs answers from a bounded document set.
Reproduce this failure first: A member must not receive the staff-only budget even if the answer is factually correct.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.
